# Pinwhy

> External memory and a visual workspace for AI agents. Pinwhy keeps an agent's judgments, evidence and current position in the project (`.pinwhy/events.jsonl`), so work resumes from the same place after context compaction, a dropped connection or a new session. Zero runtime dependencies, Node.js ≥ 18, MIT licensed, data stays local.

中文：Pinwhy 是 Agent 的外置记忆与可视化工作台。把判断、证据和当前位置记在项目本地；上下文压缩、断线或换会话之后，从同一份现场继续。

## What it is (and isn't)

- Records goals, observations, hypotheses, findings and other nodes, plus relations that the recorder declares explicitly (supports, contradicts, derived-from, …). Nothing is inferred: adding a node never draws edges or moves the cursor.
- A cursor marks where each agent is looking; checkpoints save the scene; `pinwhy context` reads it back within a token budget.
- The recovery pack is read-only and non-prescriptive: the agent decides the next step.
- Severity, status and confidence are recorded separately and never inferred from each other.
- The workspace (Context / Logic / Overview views, optional 2.5D view) listens on localhost only.

## Set it up for the user

If a user asks you to install Pinwhy, follow the official setup guide and pick the integration for your host:
[Agent setup guide](https://github.com/bx33661/pinwhy/blob/main/skills/pinwhy/references/setup.md)

1. Install a stable local copy (daily use never follows a dev branch):
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/bx33661/pinwhy.git
   cd pinwhy
   node bin/pinwhy.js release install
   export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
   ```
2. Connect the project for your host:
   - Claude Code — project Skill and recovery hook:
     `cd /path/to/your-project && pinwhy setup --target "$PWD" --title "My project" --open`
   - Codex — Codex Skill, no Claude hooks:
     `pinwhy init --title "My project" && pinwhy skill install --codex && pinwhy serve --open`
   - DeepSeek Harness — standalone plugin in `plugins/dsh-pinwhy/`:
     `dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/pinwhy/plugins/dsh-pinwhy`, then `pinwhy init --cwd /absolute/path/to/your-project --json`
   - OMP, ZCode and other hosts — copy the full Skill package `skills/pinwhy/` (with references, agents and assets) into the host's Skill directory and expand the CLI path placeholders.
   - CLI only: `pinwhy init --title "My project" && pinwhy serve --open`
3. Verify: `pinwhy status` and `pinwhy doctor`. The workspace defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4333; trust the address `status` reports. A running service does not mean the agent has loaded the Skill — check in a new session.

Keep any existing board records. Never point daily use at a development checkout.

## Everyday commands

- Record: `pinwhy node add <type> "title" [--to <id> --rel supports]`, `pinwhy link <from> <to> --rel <relation>`
- Move attention: `pinwhy cursor <id> --reason "…"`
- Save and restore: `pinwhy checkpoint --summary "…"`, `pinwhy context --budget 4000`, `pinwhy context --since <checkpoint>`
- Inspect: `pinwhy status`, `pinwhy search --type finding --group-by severity,status`
- Export: `pinwhy export --format markdown|mermaid|sarif`, `pinwhy export --out board.html`
